description_sq:
Te Zogu i Zi, prane rrethrrotulimit, shesim 2+1 perfekt per investim.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 1-re te nje pallati 6 katesh pa ashensor dhe organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, dy dhoma gjumi, tualet.
Zona eshte nje nga zonat me te mira te Tiranes me te gjitha faciletet, si bar kafe, supermarkete, shkolla, akses me Qendren e qytetit etj.
Apartamenti eshte shume i pershtatshem dhe per klinika, zyra, per shkak te fasades qe ka ne rruge kryesore.
Per me teper informacion ose nje vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni!
description_en: In Zogu i Zi, near the roundabout, we sell 2+1 perfect for investment. The apartment is located on the 1st floor of a 6-story building without an elevator and is organized in a living room with a kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom. The area is one of the best areas of Tirana with all facilities, such as coffee bars, supermarkets, schools, access to the city center, etc. The apartment is also very suitable for clinics, offices, due to its facade on the main street. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
